                info.Adornee = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                forhealth.Adornee = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                
                if (player.Team ~= localplayer.Team) then

                    forhealth.Enabled = true

                    right.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5

                    down.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5

                    down.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1

                    distancel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.1

                    healthbar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1

                    if player.Character:FindFirstChild("ForceField") then
                        outlines.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8
                    else
                        outlines.BackgroundTransparency = cheats.b_f_t
                    end
                else
                    outlines.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9
                end
                if cheats.b_sh == true then
                    if (player.Character:FindFirstChild"Humanoid") then

                    if cheats.b_ht == "Text" then
                        healthbar.Visible = false
                        healthl.Visible = true
                    end
                    if cheats.b_ht == "Bar" then
                        healthl.Visible = false
                        healthbar.Visible = true

                    if cheats.b_ht == "Both" then

                else
                    healthl.Visible = false
                    healthbar.Visible = false
                end
                if cheats.b_sn then
                    namelabel.Visible = true
                else
                    namelabel.Visible = false
                end
                if cheats.b_sd == true then
